reports.desc: I found the site while googling for a new push mower. It seemed like a great deal and the site looked legit so I made the purchase. When I try to track it all it says is processing and when I try to call the number provided on the website I get no answer

Ordered a product with a return policy. The product was inferior. I asked for label to return. They refused and they offered a 20% coupon off next item purchased and would not accept the item back or a refund. After several emails they gave me a $10.59 credit on my card and i am stuck with an inferior product. They would not honor the return policy stated on the site. Since the purchase i have had attempts made for new credit cards in my name. Not sure if it's this site but suspicious.
Just annoying calls multiple times a day from this and other types like it. Number is always spoofed. Given number was callback number

I purchased a dress from Donna's Dresses but realized within a few minutes that the company seemed like a scam. I emailed the support email address and asked for a cancellation within 20 minutes. The policy only stated that I was able to cancel my order within 4 hours, but they told me it had to be fulfilled. When I received the dress, it was poor quality, unlike the photo online. When I've emailed to request a refund, no one has responded to me.
I ordered a dress and received the wrong item. I sent pictures and the company said I received the correct item. It was by no means the correct item.
Said last chance to claim allocated waiver

I play games on my apple tablet. There are ads in between games. I saw an ad for a thing that you attach a propane bottle to and then you pull the trigger and it shoots flames to kill weeds. I ordered it thru that ad. It didn't go to a specific website.  I hit the "shop now" button and filled out everything.  I wondered why it hasn't been delivered. I looked at mt cc statement, and I saw the charge for Weresigamewell. I didn't recognize it, so I googled the name and that's where I found out they are scammers.
Pioyune is the name of the company, I purchased clothing from them never received my package,  and I never got my money back
Golden Delta is company name, I purchased clothing from them never, received my package nor got my money back
Meanloon name of company,  I  purchased clothing from them, never received my package, nor did they give me my money back
